✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between ABC Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a ABC Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base ABC Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the ABC/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- You are also responsible for providing a patch management

The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rigths are still needed.
- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.

baseline.answer:
Hello,

To renew your local administrator rights, please provide the following information so we can process a new **long-term administrator rights request**:

- Full name of your employee manager (L6 or above), or an alternative approver. If you are L6 or above, provide your own name.
- Computer name/device name. You can find it in the Company Portal or by running `hostname` in Command Prompt.
- Operating system.
- Clients and projects you currently support.
- Business justification, including the software or recurring administrative tasks requiring elevated rights.

Please confirm that the rights are required for regular, recurring business activities and that you have checked with your manager that local administrator rights do not conflict with any client requirements.

Please note that local administrator rights increase the risk to your workstation and the company infrastructure. Only business-related, appropriately licensed or approved open-source software may be installed. You must not alter the base system installation, disable security services, or install unauthorized software, and you are responsible for patching any additionally installed software.

A new request is required for renewal; approval is valid for 12 months.

Administrator rights must be requested through the **Local Administration Rights (LAR) request form**. Please complete the form with the following information:

- Whether the access is required for a one-time action or regularly
- Temporary or long-term access
- Full name of your employee manager/approver at level L6 or above

- Computer name

- Client(s) and project(s)

Please first confirm with your manager that local administrator rights are permitted under the applicable client requirements. Permanent rights are intended only for recurring business activities and require proper justification; one-time software actions should be requested as temporary access or handled by Group IT where possible. Approved rights must be renewed after 12 months.

LAR may only be used for authorized business-related software. Do not alter the base system installation, disable security services, or install unauthorized/licensed software.

✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

? Alter the base GHT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e. viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GHT/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages

Ti abbiamo assegnato il nuovo PC con Service TAG 6DTY81F Provvederemo a spedirti il nuovo PC nella filiale di Milano. Puoi darci conferma della filiale? A breve riceverai due mail: 1) Una relativa alla nuova assegnazione 2) Una relativa alla restituzione del tuo attuale device (da non considerare in caso hai esercitato il diritto di prelazione) Questo ticket verrà aggiornato quando il PC sarà disponibile per il ritiro in filiale. Ti ricordiamo che hai la possibilità di riscattare il tuo vecchio PC. Per esercitare la prelazione è sufficiente confermarlo nel ticket, successivamente verrai contattato per eseguire una formattazione da remoto. Se ricevi una mail dove ti viene chiesto di restituire il vecchio, non preoccuparti puoi ignorarla. Il prezzo è di 60 € per PC e 160 € per MacOS. NOTE: Ricorda che la prelazione è valida se: Entro 7 giorni dalla data di creazione del presente ticket eserciti il tuo diritto di prelazione. Il vecchio PC viene formattato/riconsegnato all'ufficio IT entro e non oltre 30 giorni dalla data di ritiro del nuovo device. Link utili: - Policy di assegnazione dei dispositivi aziendali https://link.placeholder/policy.pdf - Guide IT https://link.placeholder/it-guides L'IT provvederà alla cancellazione sicura dei tuoi dati ed al ripristino come condizioni di fabbrica del tuo vecchio pc. ------------------------------------------------- Your PC is obsolete and out of warranty. We will change your old device with Service TAG 9XJ72M1 to a new one. We have assigned you the new device with Service TAG 6DTY81F We will send you the new PC to the Milano office. Can you give us the confirmation of the branch? You will receive two emails: 1) Regarding the new PC assigned to you 2) Regarding the return of the old one (Please ignore if you already exercise the redeem old PC) This ticket will be updated when the device can be picked up in the office. We remind you that you can redeem your old PC. To exercise the pre-emption it's sufficient to confirm it in the ticket, after that we will contact you for resetting your old device remotely. If you'll receive an email asking you to return the old one, please ignore it. The price is 60 € for PC and 160 € for MacOS. NOTES: Remember that the pre-emption is valid if: You exercise the redemption of the old device within 7 days from the date of creation of this ticket. The old PC will be reset/returned to the IT office within 30 days from the date you picked up the new device. Useful links: - Device Policy https://link.placeholder/policy.pdf - IT Guides: https://link.placeholder/it-guides The IT will provide for the secure deletion of your data and the restoration of your old PC to factory conditions.

Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.

✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GFT/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- You are also responsible for providing a patch

A breve riceverai due mail: 1)Una relativa alla nuova assegnazione 2)Una relativa alla restituzione del tuo attuale device (da non considerare in caso hai esercitato il diritto di prelazione) Questo ticket verrà aggiornato quando il PC sarà disponibile per il ritiro in filiale. Ti ricordiamo che hai la possibilità di riscattare il tuo vecchio PC. Per esercitare la prelazione è sufficiente confermarlo nel ticket, successivamente verrai contattato per eseguire una formattazione da remoto. Se ricevi una mail dove ti viene chiesto di restituire il vecchio, non preoccuparti puoi ignorarla. Il prezzo è di 60 € per PC e 160 € per MacOS. NOTE: Ricorda che la prelazione è valida se: Entro 7 giorni dalla data di creazione del presente ticket eserciti il tuo diritto di prelazione. Il vecchio PC viene formattato/riconsegnato all'ufficio IT entro e non oltre 30 giorni dalla data di ritiro del nuovo device. Link utili: - Policy di assegnazione dei dispositivi aziendali [https://short.url/link1](https://short.url/link1) - Guide IT [help.gft.com](https://short.url/link2) L'IT provvederà alla cancellazione sicura dei tuoi dati ed al ripristino come condizioni di fabbrica del tuo vecchio pc. ------------------------------------------------- Your PC is obsolete and out of warranty. We will change your old device with Service TAG RX7V4HZ to a new one. We have assigned you the new device with Service TAG D4N0M3W We will send you the new PC to the Milan office. Can you give us the confirmation of the branch? You will receive two emails: 1) Regarding the new PC assigned to you 2) Regarding the return of the old one (Please ignore if you already exercise the redeem old PC) This ticket will be updated when the device can be picked up in the office. We remind you that you can redeem your old PC. To exercise the pre-emption it's sufficient to confirm it in the ticket, after that we will contact you for resetting your old device remotely. If you'll receive an email asking you to return the old one, please ignore it. The price is 60 € for PC and 160 € for MacOS. NOTES: Remember that the pre-emption is valid if: You exercise the redemption of the old device within 7 days from the date of creation of this ticket. The old PC will be reset/returned to the IT office within 30 days from the date you picked up the new device. Useful links: - Device Policy [https://short.url/link1](https://short.url/link1) - IT Guides: [help.gft.com](https://short.url/link2) The IT will provide for the secure deletion of your data and the restoration of your old PC to factory conditions.
